use.zh-cn: 任务／执行、预检权限与三态；replace需实例、插件和Provider删除能力，unsupported优先。Describe保留Meta类型，运行保护核对不扩权。复核已有bounded/continuous Worker分工、格式与raw copy继承差别、CDC扫描及运行策略正文归属；停止态native创建仍无执行、调度或扫描，encoded执行未建模。
use.en: Task/execution, tri-state precheck and permissions; replace needs instance/plugin delete support and Provider; unsupported wins. Describe preserves Meta types and runtime protection adds no grants. Reviewed existing worker split, encoded/raw-copy distinctions, CDC scans and runtime-policy references retain stopped native creation: no execution, schedule or scan; encoded execution remains unmodeled.

use.zh-cn: 委托创建仍限租户内停止态 bounded/snapshot/native table，无调度、扫描或执行，固化当前 AuthContext。人工启动／恢复因未核清 Cleanup 围栏返回 409 和安全双语 transfer_cleanup_unresolved；删除清理失败仍优先 503。人工运行／角色及 Cleanup 未纳入创建能力，不扩权、不借用角色或解除围栏。
use.en: Delegated creation stays tenant-scoped stopped bounded/snapshot/native table without schedules, scans or execution, using current AuthContext. Manual start/resume cleanup-fence refusals return 409 and safe localized transfer_cleanup_unresolved; failed delete cleanup retains 503 precedence. Manual execution, roles and Cleanup remain outside creation scope: no wider grants, borrowed roles or fence release.

use.zh-cn: 创建仍只保存 idle/stopped 定义：默认无新增角色或 EA 依赖，显式方式复核本人角色，委托不借用角色。新增私有保护记录仅用于已核验 Manager/Develop 来源的 ExportSession 一次性执行，不授予权限、不变换字段或写业务数据。导出生成与再次交付仍未建模，创建 Tool 的条件、确认和效果不变。
use.en: Creation still saves an idle/stopped definition; default choices add no role or EA dependency, explicit choices check the current User, and delegation borrows no roles. A private protection receipt is initialized only for verified Manager/Develop ExportSession ad-hoc executions: no grants, field changes or business writes. Export generation and redelivery remain unmodeled; create Tool conditions, confirmation and effects are unchanged.

use.zh-cn: 正式委托路由覆盖创建停止态与拒绝错误范围、执行、计划、扫描；新增角色选择请求必须 409，且零本人角色请求、不增加定义或执行。
use.en: The formal delegated route covers stopped creation and rejects wrong scopes, execution, schedules and scanning; a role-choice request must return 409 with no current-user role lookup or additional definition/execution.

use.zh-cn: 创建v3与正式预检的输入、权限及模式边界未变；Owner事实v3和可选草稿v4改用原始分段query_references，拒绝旧平面字段。Source Engine ID契约未变，不新增写入、执行、调度或扫描效果。
use.en: Create v3 and formal precheck retain input, permission and mode boundaries. Owner facts v3 and optional draft v4 use exact query_references parts and reject the old flat field. Source Engine ID is unchanged; no write, execution, schedule or scan effect is added.

use.zh-cn: 共享ResourceFact局部$defs展开后逐项比较验证规则，结构化引用的必填、封闭结构和名称约束不被忽略；创建标准类型、快照replace/append与upsert/keys/计划/凭据拒绝断言保持。
use.en: Resolve local ResourceFact $defs before comparing every validation rule, retaining structured-reference requirements, closed objects and name constraints. Existing standard-type, snapshot replace/append and rejection tests for upsert, keys, schedules and credentials remain.

use.zh-cn: 源MQL集合仅取Owner的query_references.mql.parts唯一原始元素，不拆full_name或locator；原草稿参数沿用、正式复核、创建一次及失败不重试流程未变，事实表示变化不能借机改写原参数。
use.en: Take the source MQL collection only from the unique exact owner query_references.mql.parts element, never by splitting full_name or locator. Original draft parameters, formal review, single creation and no retry remain; a fact-format change does not authorize rewriting arguments.

use.zh-cn: confirmed_source要求正式结构化事实，MQL aggregate必须与Owner的单分段引用精确匹配，无旧字段兜底；条件列表、预检及复核算法未改，但事实内容进入完整指纹，刷新后的引用或能力修订变化必须重新确认。
use.en: confirmed_source requires formal structured facts; MQL aggregate must exactly match the owner single-part reference, without a legacy fallback. Conditions, precheck and review algorithms are unchanged, but the full fingerprint binds facts, so refreshed references or a new capability revision require renewed confirmation.

use.zh-cn: 结构化事实夹具仍核验缺失证据、样本补位、旧确认、参数或事实变化拒绝；快照仅replace/append、upsert和keys拒绝及unknown知情确认边界保持。
use.en: Structured-fact fixtures retain refusals for missing evidence, sample substitution, stale review and changed arguments or facts. Snapshot replace/append only, upsert and keys refusal, and informed unknown precheck confirmation remain.

use.zh-cn: 支持矩阵、bounded语义及快照replace/append与增量upsert区分保持。复核continuous提交、租约恢复、诊断、停止清理与扫描的权威正文引用；Oracle及运行限制保留。写后仅扫目标表，创建仍禁扫描，不扩业务Kafka、watermark或停止态native创建，不把观测或声明当运行验收。
use.en: The matrix, bounded semantics and snapshot replace/append versus incremental upsert remain. Reviewed canonical references for continuous commits, leases/recovery, diagnostics, stop/cleanup and scans preserve Oracle/runtime limits. Post-write scans target only; creation disables scans. No expansion of business Kafka, watermark or stopped native creation, and no runtime proof from observations or declarations.

use.zh-cn: 确认恢复重读原参数、本体及源/目标事实，复检指纹、消费确认并经提交屏障创建一次；变化重确认、失败不重试。同批按模型顺序执行并在搜索失败或取消时阻断；显式预检固定展示并结束。私有 answer_ready 在原预算内进入无工具正文流；不公开决策，不改权限或固定提示。
use.en: Confirmed resume rereads exact arguments, ontology and source/target facts, checks fingerprints and consumes review before one commit-gated Adapter creation. Changes require review; errors never retry. Ordered batches stop on search errors or cancellation; explicit checks end with fixed output. Private answer_ready enters tool-free text streaming within the original budget; decisions stay private and permissions/fixed messages stay unchanged.

use.zh-cn: 真实 Harness/Manifest/SDK 夹具覆盖确认恢复零模型调用、原参数创建一次、变化重确认、取消、权限拒绝、unsupported、提交失败和结果不明不重试。回答调用纳入原预算，正式预检与固定提示断言保持；非真实部署或 Hosted 验收。
use.en: Real Harness/Manifest/SDK fixtures cover zero-model confirmed resume, one exact creation, changed-fact review, cancellation, denial, unsupported checks, failed commit and no uncertain-write retry. Answer calls count within the budget; formal checks and fixed-message assertions remain. Not live deployment or Hosted acceptance.

use.zh-cn: 显式预检的双语三态完成提示，以及确认恢复后仅基于正式创建响应的固定成功提示；失败不宣称已创建，unknown 不标为通过。 计划/工作区展示不改变创建条件、确认或权限。 仅新增回复偏好不能覆盖恢复中运行的双语输入错误。
use.en: Localized tri-state explicit-check completion and fixed confirmed-resume completion based only on the formal creation response; failure never claims creation, and unknown is not passed. Workspace plans confer no creation authority. Adds only a localized input error forbidding reply preference overrides on resume.

use.zh-cn: 复核 KML 固定 CRS 与 encoded ORC 单文件 reader／源版本绑定；本轮只扩展未建模的 encoded 读取。停止态 native table 的 bounded/snapshot、replace/append、查询与字段资格校验，以及创建权限、条件和效果保持；不执行、调度或扫描。
use.en: Review KML fixed CRS and encoded ORC single-file reading with source-version binding. Encoded execution remains unmodeled. Stopped native creation retains bounded/snapshot, replace/append, query and field checks, permissions, conditions and effects; no execution, schedule or scan.

use.zh-cn: 精确历史参数只由受身份限定的已完成预检步骤恢复；普通确认从同一 Run/协议调用下本次复核的唯一自动预检建立引用，并核对参数、报告与确认指纹，不选最近草稿、不复制参数到检查点。
use.en: Exact arguments come only from identity-scoped completed check steps. Ordinary confirmation binds its unique automatic check within the same run/invocation, validating parameters, report and review fingerprint without selecting a recent draft or duplicating checkpoint arguments.

use.zh-cn: 历史草稿动作先于通用领域分类；inspect不读平台目录或装配业务Tool，create仍重读原参数并进入当前平台语义。提示词与原互斥拒绝校验对齐，不自动纠正或重试矛盾路由。只记录封闭动作及布尔标志；不继承旧事实、确认或权限，原参数和创建路径不变。
use.en: Historical draft actions precede generic domain classification. Inspect uses no platform directory or business tools; create re-reads exact arguments and current platform semantics. Prompts align with unchanged exclusive-route refusals, without auto-correction or retry. Logs contain only closed actions and flags; no historical facts, confirmation or authority are inherited.

use.zh-cn: 同身份读取原草稿，文字、卡片与最新计划按原事件顺序投影。forwardedProps 只接收封闭回复详略，冻结于新 Run，resume 不覆盖。正文批次与同消息投影先提交再发送；完成与取消互斥，未完成正文排除未来上下文和摘要，不改变预检、确认或业务效果。
use.en: Reads scoped drafts and projects text, cards and the latest plan in event order. Closed reply detail is frozen in each new Run, never replaced on resume. Text batches and one message projection commit before delivery; completion is serialized against cancellation. Partial text stays visible but is excluded from later context/summary. Prechecks, review and business effects stay unchanged.

use.zh-cn: 保留全部原草稿范围与确认拒绝测试，新增历史解释真实流在结束前交付、原参数卡片一致且无业务Tool，以及矛盾路由在读取/装配前拒绝、日志不含用户正文/引用/凭据的反例。不作为真实模型或当前部署验收。
use.en: Retain all prior draft-scope and confirmation-refusal tests. Add early historical explanation streaming with exact parameter cards and no business tools, plus invalid-route rejection before reads/tools and closed logs excluding text, references and credentials. Controlled tests do not prove a live model or deployment.

use.zh-cn: 受控持久层核对草稿引用、原参数、文字顺序和完整 content；同消息逐批更新，计划按稳定身份替换，安全事件保留各次更新。正式卡片与固定提示断言保持；非真实数据库或部署验收。
use.en: Controlled persistence checks exact draft references, arguments, text order and full content. One message updates incrementally; plans replace under stable identity while safe events retain updates. Formal cards and fixed-message assertions stay intact; not live database or deployment acceptance.

use.zh-cn: 只合并相邻文字，不跨 Presentation 重排；持久化仍使用原字节上限和深复制，不过滤内容
use.en: Merge only adjacent text without reordering across presentations; persistence retains byte bounds and deep copying without filtering content

use.zh-cn: 验证空 delta、相邻合并与卡片后的新文字段，不丢弃模型输出
use.en: Verify empty deltas, adjacent merging and new text after cards without dropping model output

use.zh-cn: 从同一已预检参数显示受限事实概要，复用共享定位符、表格和 JSON；长名称完整换行，不新增事实、任务状态、action 或请求。
use.en: Display bounded facts from the same checked arguments using shared locators, tables and JSON. Wrap complete long names without adding facts, task state, actions or requests.

use.zh-cn: 核对概要和原参数一致、双语、路径与名称转义、缺失事实不猜测、完整 JSON 和无 action；Catalog 拒绝越界和额外属性
use.en: Verify same-argument facts, languages, escaped paths and names, no invented missing facts, complete JSON and no actions; Catalog rejects oversized and extra properties

use.zh-cn: 文字与 A2UI 保持事件顺序，计划按稳定身份替换。设置复用 addp-module，单次 NavigationDraft 跨 iframe 只移交文字，领取前禁用编辑与发送；归档仍阻止交互提交。刷新按服务端标记展示未完成正文，不拼接重试，不继承确认、预检、资源或权限。
use.en: Preserves text/A2UI order and stable plan replacement. Settings uses addp-module; one NavigationDraft transfers only text across iframes with editing/sending blocked until receipt. Archiving blocks interaction submission. Reload shows server-marked incomplete text without joining retries or inheriting confirmations, checks, resources or authority.

use.zh-cn: 仅对齐RouteDecision的互斥字段说明：inspect要求skill=null且平台语义false，create要求skill=null且平台语义true；无草稿动作才通用分类。原字段、类型、默认值、封闭Schema及请求身份/原参数/检查点边界不变，不恢复direct_reply或新增授权。
use.en: Align only RouteDecision field descriptions: inspect requires no skill and false platform semantics; create requires no skill and true semantics; generic classification applies without a draft action. Fields, types, defaults, closed schema, request identity, exact arguments and checkpoint boundaries stay unchanged; no direct_reply or added authority.

use.zh-cn: 保留当前Run事实与原草稿控制引用，不持久化第二份参数；正式事实捕获仅投影共享模型验证的query_references原始分段，非法引用不补齐，旧平面字段不转换为新证据。normalize_checkpoint、确认记录及reply_detail边界未变。
use.en: Retain current-run facts and the original draft control reference, without a second argument payload. Formal fact capture projects only model-validated exact query_references parts; invalid references are not filled and legacy flat fields are not upgraded into evidence. normalize_checkpoint, confirmation records and reply_detail boundaries are unchanged.

use.zh-cn: T3 使用生产 UI/协议客户端与受控 HTTP/SSE 核对文字、卡片顺序、刷新后的原参数与引用；长草稿名在窄屏不溢出。禁止夹具访问个人服务，不作为真实模型或 Hosted T4 验收。 受控浏览器验证IME和快捷键、新消息携带偏好、澄清仍恢复原身份且不覆盖偏好。
use.en: T3 uses production UI/client with controlled HTTP/SSE to verify content order and reloaded exact arguments/references, including narrow long-name layout. Fixtures forbid personal service calls and do not prove live-model or Hosted T4 acceptance. Controlled browser checks IME/shortcuts and preferences on new messages; clarification preserves its identity without overriding the preference.

use.zh-cn: 角色方式保存只消费当前第一方 User 的角色事实；无选择直接返回。角色手动执行需独立 EA，不赋予委托创建运行权。
use.en: Role-choice saves consume only current first-party User role facts; absent choices return directly. Manual role execution requires separate EA and does not grant delegated creation execution rights.

use.zh-cn: 本人角色读取要求未到期第一方 Tenant User，拒绝 Delegated／Service，不替换服务令牌、不保存凭据；不授予数据或执行权限。
use.en: Current role reads require a live first-party Tenant User and reject Delegated/Service identities without substituting service tokens or retaining credentials; no data or execution permission is granted.

use.zh-cn: 只接受已持久化的正式 Interaction 确认，普通创建绑定本次唯一预检引用后恢复原 Run；文字回答清除复核，不构成批准，不复制第二份参数。 新Run持久表达偏好；恢复与重试不覆盖，不新增确认来源。
use.en: Accepts persisted formal Interaction confirmation, binding the exact check reference before resuming the same run; text clears review rather than approving, with no duplicate argument store. New Runs persist expression preferences, preserved on resume/retry without a new confirmation source.

use.zh-cn: 真实 Harness 受控倒序到达复现五类搜索错误竞态，严格禁止备用调用与下一轮模型；覆盖成功顺序、取消阻断及重复身份拒绝。夹具显式区分决策和回答并审计私有控制；计划与正文流不改变创建条件或权限。
use.en: Real Harness reverse-arrival fixtures reproduce five search-error races and strictly forbid fallback calls or another decision round. Tests preserve successful order, cancellation stops and duplicate-ID rejection. Fixtures explicitly separate decisions/answers and audit private controls; plans and text streaming confer no creation authority.

sources.anchor: 同批 Tool 按模型返回顺序进入唯一 Runtime 调用路径

use.zh-cn: 明确Owner事实v3/可选草稿v4及结构化查询引用，Source Engine身份不替换为Query Runtime；同批模型顺序、前序失败/暂停/终止/取消阻断条款逐字未变。事实、草稿和查询引用均不授予权限，也不扩大停止态native创建范围。
use.en: Specify owner facts v3, optional drafts v4 and structured query references without replacing Source Engine identity with a Query Runtime. The model-order batch and prior failure/pause/termination/cancellation barrier paragraph is byte-for-byte unchanged. Facts, drafts and query references grant no authority and do not expand stopped native creation.

summary.zh-cn: 只建未启动的 native table 有界快照任务，目标仅 replace/append；复核和创建前正式只读预检，unsupported 阻止创建，unknown 明示限制后知情确认；不保证实际值转换或执行成功，不是 Transfer 全功能声明
summary.en: Create only a stopped native table bounded snapshot task with replace/append; formal read-only checks precede review and creation, unsupported blocks creation and unknown requires informed confirmation; no guarantee of value conversion, execution success or full Transfer coverage

summary.zh-cn: Continuous/Kafka 与数据库 CDC尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: Continuous Kafka and database CDC is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: Watermark 增量装载尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: Watermark incremental load is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: 执行、重试、调度及运行结果尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: Execution, retry, scheduling and runtime results is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: 文件、对象与 raw copy 传输尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: File, object and raw copy transfer is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: 当前第一方 User 的角色专用字段方式、手动 EA 执行及导出交付尚未纳入本委托创建能力；不借用发布人、服务或委托人角色。
summary.en: Current first-party User role-specific field choices, manual EA execution and export delivery are not modeled by this delegated creation capability; publisher, service or delegator roles are not borrowed.
